ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, from left to right, there is a string of connected triangles, and the problem states that each triangle is a 45°-45°-90° triangle. The base of the large triangle on the far left is labeled 6, and there is a right-angle mark at the vertex, so this base is the hypotenuse of that triangle. Its right-side slanted side also serves as the hypotenuse of the next triangle; there is a vertical line segment in the middle. Farther to the right, the middle vertical line segment serves as the hypotenuse of the next 45°-45°-90° triangle; finally, the base of the small triangle on the right is labeled x. Reasoning: In a 45°-45°-90° triangle, if the hypotenuse is h, then each leg is h/√2. The leftmost triangle has hypotenuse 6, so one of its legs, namely the slanted line from the upper-left vertex to the middle bottom point, has length 6/√2. This slanted line is the hypotenuse of the next 45°-45°-90° triangle, therefore the length of the middle vertical line segment is (6/√2)/√2 = 6/2 = 3. Next, the middle vertical line segment is the hypotenuse of the next 45°-45°-90° triangle on the right, so the length of the slanted line from the middle bottom point to the upper-right point is 3/√2. Finally, this slanted line is the hypotenuse of the small 45°-45°-90° triangle on the far right, and the base x is its leg, so x = (3/√2)/√2 = 3/2.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as a chain of four 45°-45°-90° triangles from left to right. Let the left bottom base segment labeled 6 be the hypotenuse of the leftmost triangle, whose top vertex is marked as a right angle. Its slanted leg from the top-left vertex to the central bottom vertex therefore has length 6/√2. That same slanted segment is the hypotenuse of the next right-isosceles triangle formed with the top horizontal segment and the central vertical segment, so the central vertical segment has length (6/√2)/√2 = 3. In the next triangle to the right, this central vertical segment is the hypotenuse, so the diagonal from the central bottom vertex to the upper-right point is 3/√2. Finally, in the rightmost small triangle, that diagonal is the hypotenuse and the bottom segment labeled x is a leg, so x = (3/√2)/√2 = 3/2.
